title: Swap case
statementMd:
Return `s` with uppercase letters lowered and lowercase letters uppercased; other characters stay.

**Example:** `swap_case("Hello World")` returns `"hELLO wORLD"`.
referenceSolution:
def swap_case(s):
    return ''.join(c.lower() if c.isupper() else c.upper() for c in s)
